integrity: A self-contained all-index proof with exact finite regression checker; numerical checks are not infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Coprimality is established only in characteristic zero and at offsets two and three; no exact resultant formula, sign law or all-offset result is asserted. Priority assessment cannot exclude unindexed stronger results.
title: Second- and third-neighbor coprimality of coefficient-Stern polynomials
